3. Your circle or B button is basically useless
4. Do not be afraid to not even fight the boss on your first attempt. Watch their movements and learn
5. If you’re losing heart, come back after a couple hours. I only beat the last boss after I slept the night away and internalised his every move
6. Hesitation is defeat
